description: A Simplicity covenant on Bitcoin. Locks coins under a program the node itself executes, then spends them by satisfying it — the same p2pk.simf that runs on Liquid, unchanged.

p2pk_vault.description: Coins spendable only by a BIP340 signature over the whole transaction, checked on-chain by Simplicity rather than by Bitcoin script.

PUB_KEY.description: x-only key the covenant checks against. Take it from `info` (Wallet Signing Key), so this wallet can satisfy it.

Lock.intent: Lock {params.amount_sat} sat under a Simplicity covenant

Unlock.description: Spend the covenant by satisfying its program.
Unlock.intent: Unlock the covenant and send to {params.dest}
Unlock.$comment: No change output: the amount formula accounts for the fee exactly, so any surplus would be an error rather than a silently invented output.

inputs.$comment: The witness the program reads. `type: Signature` means the engine computes sig_all_hash from the transaction it just built and signs it with the named key — so the value signed is by construction the one the program checks.
